MRI of scans of his entire spine show increased tumor burden in his lumbar and cervical spine causing multiple areas of severe stenosis. You are also able to identify new lesions seeding his peritoneum.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
